title: India's edible oil self-reliance push (NMEO-OS & NMEO-OP)
summary: Oilseed production: 43.06 MT (2025-26, 3rd AE), up from 39 MT (2022-23); cumulative oil palm area: 6.40 lakh ha (Mar 2026)...

items: Oilseed production: 43.06 MT (2025-26, 3rd AE), up from 39 MT (2022-23); cumulative oil palm area: 6.40 lakh ha (Mar 2026)
NMEO-OS: approved Oct 3, 2024 — target 69.7 MT by 2030-31 | NMEO-OP: launched Aug 2021 — outlay ₹11,040 Cr

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Don't confuse NMEO-OS (oilseeds, 2024) with NMEO-OP (oil palm, 2021, ₹11,040 Cr).
